name: useArray
description: A hook that provides various methods to manipulate an array.

name: useBoolean
description: A hook that manages a boolean state with helper methods to set it to true or false.

name: useCounter
description: A hook that manages a numeric counter state with increment, decrement, and reset functions.

name: useCycle
description: A hook that cycles through a list of values on each invocation of the cycle function.

name: useDefault
description: A hook that returns a default value if the current state is null or undefined.

name: useQuery
description: A hook that executes an asynchronous function and manages loading, error, and success states.
